description: Domain registrar identity verification request. High priority, deadline in 72 hours.

messages.raw:
From: Registrar Compliance <compliance@registrar.example>
To: demo@local.test
Subject: Action required: verify registrant contact for example.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Message-ID: <verify-88213@registrar.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

Hello,

We are completing a periodic registrant verification for the domain example.com,
registered to your account. Under our registrar accreditation requirements we must
confirm the registrant contact details for every domain we host.

Please complete identity verification for example.com within 7 days.

Why this matters: failure to complete verification may result in the domain being
suspended and the registrant contact record being deleted. A suspended domain
cannot be renewed or transferred until verification is completed.

To complete verification, sign in to your registrar account and confirm the
registrant organisation and contact phone number. The whole process takes about
five minutes. If the details on record are correct, the verification completes
immediately.

If you no longer control this domain, reply to this message so we can correct the
registrant record.

Registrar Compliance Team
